name: Trastuzumab emtansine
mechanism: Trastuzumab conjugated via a non-cleavable thioether linker to DM1, a maytansinoid microtubule inhibitor. Retains trastuzumab's mechanisms and delivers payload intracellularly after lysosomal degradation, with minimal bystander effect.
monitoring: Platelet counts and liver function before each dose
resistance: Reduced HER2 expression, impaired lysosomal processing, altered trafficking and drug efflux.
